_meta.description: The Modules page (openspec/changes/simple-structure-profile, openspec/changes/modules-page-as-board). A `links` page as board PqModules draws it: the six modules as module cards (nextcloud-vue 2.108.0 `modules`), each with its pages as links, an In-the-menu badge read from `runtime.menu.enabled.<module>` (src/utils/menuRuntime.js) and for an administrator the way to the admin settings; then the pages that belong to no module as two list cards, Also in Pipelinq and More (`groupStyle: list`). The library leaves out a page whose route does not resolve, so tests/vitest/modulesBoard.spec.js mounts the page. The page exists in both structure profiles so its address is stable; only the simple menu links to it (`ModulesMenu` in src/menu-layout.simple.json).

config.description: Every page that is not in the daily menu. An administrator can add a module to the menu in the admin settings.
config.footnote: An administrator turns a module on in the admin settings, and then it is in the menu for everyone. A module that is off still opens from this page.
